feeds.title: iPleaders » Investment Law
feeds.description: Sharing insights on legal issues and investment law. iPleaders consists of a team of lawyers hell-bent on figuring out ways to make law more accessible. While the lack of access to affordable and timely legal support cuts across all sectors, classes and people in India, where it is missed most, surprisingly, are business situations. It advocates that businessmen, including technology entrepreneurs can manage the majority of legal issues by themselves efficiently if they are equipped with basic knowledge and resources.

feeds.title: Leiden Law » International Investment Law
feeds.description: The Leiden Law Blog stands out by responding to current news and developments related to investment law, while also focussing on the research conducted at our faculty. It is published by Leiden Law School, Leiden University, the oldest and highest ranked law faculty in the Netherlands.

feeds.title: EFILA Blog
feeds.description: The European Federation for Investment Law Blog is intended to offer a common space that fosters dialogue between specialists of different views in an effective and user-friendly manner, allowing discussions to move beyond the stalemate of isolated monologues that fail to truly address the salient issues of the moment. Therefore, the Blog is meant to provide a balanced view that attempts to avoid any hegemonic assumptions.

feeds.title: International Institute for Sustainable Development » Investment treatty News
feeds.description: News, analysis and opinions on international investment law. The International Institute for Sustainable Development (IISD) is an independent think tank championing sustainable solutions to 21st century problems. Their mission is to promote human development and environmental sustainability. They do this through research, analysis and knowledge products that support sound policy-making.
